stories.title: Mold Town Council office closed after doors and windows smashed
stories.summary: Mold Town Council’s offices have been damaged after glass in the entrance doors and surrounding windows was smashed, the council has confirmed. stories.title: Deeside’s Iceland Foods becomes first UK high street brand in the Falkland Islands
stories.summary: Deeside-based Iceland Foods will become the first UK high street retailer to open a store in the Falkland Islands. The new store, at K4, Ross Road East in the capital Stanley, will open in early December under a franchise partnership with local retailer Kelper Stores, part of the Fortuna group. stories.title: Second fly-tipping incident at protected site near Halkyn, NRW says
stories.summary: Used motor oil has been fly-tipped for a second time at Moel-y-Crio near Halkyn, Flintshire, Natural Resources Wales has said. NRW attended the site alongside North Wales Police’s Rural Crime Team after reports that several drums of oil had been dumped. stories.title: Poultry giant wants to process 38,000 more birds a day in Sandycroft, here’s how to comment
stories.summary: A public consultation has opened on plans to increase the number of birds processed and add a seventh working day at the poultry plant in Sandycroft, but residents can only object to noise and smell, not the extra day itself.
